Name: Test Matrix
Description: User provides PA values for different speed/flow/accel combinations

Name: Min PA Value
Description: Minimum PA from all test results
Notes: Lowest PA that worked across all conditions

Name: Max PA Value
Description: Maximum PA from all test results
Notes: Highest PA that worked across all conditions

Name: PA Range
Notes: Shows how much PA varies across conditions

Name: Adaptive Min PA
Notes: Recommended minimum for adaptive PA range

Name: Adaptive Max PA
Notes: Recommended maximum for adaptive PA range

Name: Adaptive Step
Description: Incremental step size for adaptive tuning

Name: Common Example
Description: Test Results: Min PA = 0.035 | Max PA = 0.085 | Range = 0.050 → Adaptive Min = 0.030 | Adaptive Max = 0.090 | Step = 0.003125
